turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Namaste, main SBI bank ka representative bol raha hoon. Aapka KYC update nahi hua hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapka account 24 ghante mein band ho jayega. Abhi update karna hoga.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapke phone pe jo message aaya hai, usme 6 digit code hai, woh bataiye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Main CBI officer Verma bol raha hoon. Aapke naam pe non-bailable warrant hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aapka Aadhaar ek drug case mein link hua hai. Aapko turant 50,000 rupaye transfer karne honge case clear karne ke liye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aur kisi ko mat batana. Line mat katna. Yeh classified investigation hai.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is SBI fraud prevention. We noticed an unusual transaction of 15,000 rupees from your account.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We have blocked the transaction for your safety. Please do not share any OTP or PIN with anyone. Visit your nearest branch to verify.
